Subject: Responses canonical event and tool lifecycle freeze
Facts: Responses tool calls round-trip by call_id; partial argument deltas are not executable until finalization. Freeze whether tool-call completion is a provider-terminal outcome or a nonterminal agent handoff; distinguish response.incomplete/max_output from normal completion; define response.failed, in-band errors, HTTP errors, cancellation vs disconnect, usage absence, and duplicate/gapped upstream sequence behavior. Offline fixtures should cover text stream, multiple interleaved calls, malformed/truncated stream, limits, errors, and local cancellation. No secrets belong in fixture payloads.
Impact: Determines CanonicalModelEvent terminal semantics and no-blind-retry behavior used by FakeProvider and all adapters.
RequestedAction: Freeze shared canonical terminal, tool-ready, usage, cancellation, and sequence policies; leave adapter wire mapping protocol-specific.

Subject: Chat Completions compatibility and stream fixtures
Facts: Chat tool_calls stream as indexed incremental fragments; id/type/name can appear only in initial fragments, arguments are concatenated by index, and include_usage may send a final choices-empty chunk that may be absent after disconnect. Freeze supported roles and tool-result mapping, n/choice policy, finish_reason mapping, legacy function_call policy, configured-only vendor extensions, and absent-vs-zero usage semantics.
Impact: Prevents canonical tool state and usage from depending on vendor-only fields or missing stream trailers.
RequestedAction: Freeze role/tool mapping, finish-reason and terminal semantics, and explicit compatibility-profile behavior.

Subject: Anthropic current wire-version and message semantics
Facts: Official docs current on 2026-10-26 recommend anthropic-version 2026-10-21; direct API accepts Bearer auth and legacy x-api-key. That version rejects non-default temperature, top_p, and top_k. Freeze an explicit auth/profile/version policy, per-stop_reason outcome mapping, cumulative usage snapshot semantics, tool_result ordering/ids, refusal/unknown block behavior, and local-abort versus disconnect semantics. No server tools/MCP are in current scope.
Impact: The current draft version/auth/sampling mapping is insufficient to implement a correct Anthropic adapter.
RequestedAction: Freeze the Anthropic profile against version 2026-10-21 and explicitly reject unsupported sampling values.

Subject: Memory scopes, consent, provenance and forget acceptance
Facts: Freeze account+conversation/group+sender scope keys; require explicit identity links and revoke/cache invalidation; preserve system/developer/current trusted message priority before recent conversation, explicitly linked active task, preferences, and authorized group memory; keep recalled history low-trust. Writes require user request or explicit confirmation, retain source provenance/operation id, reject secrets/sensitive data without logging contents, and forget/tombstone matching records and derived summaries. TTL, migration, backup and key rotation remain separate tasks.
Impact: Defines cross-scope safety and deterministic acceptance cases for Memory and ContextSelector.
RequestedAction: Freeze scope key structure, consent semantics, context priority/budget, provenance, and deletion guarantees.
